import sys,json,time,unittest,hashlib
from pathlib import Path

modules=['test_fcpxml','test_lens_compositor','test_lens_geometry','test_interchange','test_install_macos']

def inventory():return {p:hashlib.sha256((Path(sys.argv[1])/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
before=inventory();began=time.monotonic();suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(modules);result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite);after=inventory()

(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report));raise SystemExit(0 if report['passed'] else 1)
